subject: Drawing thin lines between some rows and some columns of a geom_raster

messages.author: d994cff5897faec8
messages.subject: Drawing thin lines between some rows and some columns of a geom_raster
parts:
Does anyone have code off the top of their head to draw thin lines
*between* some of the rows, and *between* some of the columns, of a
geom_raster on discrete x- and y-axes? I know (approximately) how to
draw lines *through* the rows or columns, but not *between*.

Ideally, I'd like lines automatically placed between the levels of a
secondary factor that is correlated with the x- or y-axis factor. For
instance, here's some fake data:

dat <- structure(list(Var1 = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 1L,
2L, 3L), .Label = c("a", "b", "c"), class = "factor"), Var2 = structure(c(1L,
1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("x", "y", "z"), class = "factor"),
Cat1 = structure(c(1L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 1L, 2L), .Label = c("1",
"2"), class = "factor"), Cat2 = structure(c(2L, 2L, 2L, 1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L), .Label = c("p", "q"), class = "factor"),
n = c(-0.118643517286779, -0.836055986263779, 0.680206695378796,
-0.557798185459975, 0.112784530939669, -0.326098397493879,
0.416309214714457, -0.867085759851396, 1.05378891071062)), .Names
= c("Var1",
"Var2", "Cat1", "Cat2", "n"), out.attrs = structure(list(dim = c(3L,
3L), dimnames = structure(list(Var1 = c("Var1=a", "Var1=b", "Var1=c"
), Var2 = c("Var2=x", "Var2=y", "Var2=z")), .Names = c("Var1",
"Var2"))), .Names = c("dim", "dimnames")), row.names = c(NA,
-9L), class = "data.frame")

which can be plotted as

ggplot(dat, aes(x=Var1, y=Var2, fill=n)) + geom_raster()

and I want thin lines between the 'b' and 'c' columns, because Cat1
divides Var1 into [a,b]+[c], and between the 'x' and 'y' rows, because
Cat2 divides Var2 into [x]+[y,z].

Any help is most appreciated.

zw

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Drawing thin lines between some rows and some columns of a geom_raster
parts:
Here's one approach:

ggplot(dat, aes(x=Var1, y=Var2, fill=n)) + geom_raster() +
geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, color = "yellow", size = 0.5) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, color = "yellow", size = 0.5)

using the numeric values of the factor levels as a reference for the lines.

Dennis
